notes:
- **Archie Mobile is a choice in the Chat app list**, beside the chat apps. Pick it once a phone is
  connected, and your agent answers in Archie and on Archie Mobile instead of on a chat app. Pick a
  chat app you connected before, and your agent uses it, with nothing else to press.
- **Disconnect a chat app from one agent** on its Setup tab, under Chat app. The app's token stays
  under Settings, Saved keys, for your other agents.
- Fixed: Ember faces that stand still, like the ones on Personalities and in the store, had no eyes.
- Fixed: when your Mac had not let Archie read Messages, Text Replies showed the Mac's own error with
  no Open Full Disk Access button, and the skill showed no warning.
- Fixed: reloading Archie on the Setup tab went back to AI account.
- Fixed: picking an AI account you had saved before still needed a press on Use this AI.
- Fixed: Redo introduction and Run the introduction anyway left you on the Setup tab instead of
  opening the chat where your agent asks its questions.
